name: Seito Youroku ~Lolita Shoujo wa Ore Shidai~
original_name: 性徒幼録～ロリータ少女は俺次第～
source:
The protagonist is a teacher and happens to learn the weak point of an insolent girl in the class named Maria.
When all the students have gone home, the special class of the two starts...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE053264.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名老师，偶然发现了班上一个名叫玛丽亚的傲慢女孩的弱点。
当所有的学生都回家后，两人的特殊班级开始了……
